title: Rain Flooding

items.label: Low Walkway
items.description: People step through water covering a low walking route after rain.

items.local_cue: a Rajshahi city street after intense monsoon rain, with concrete walkways, small shopfronts, easy bikes and clogged roadside outlets. In this cutout specifically, make the decisive evidence prominent: pedestrians wading through water covering a low footpath

questions: Which two scenes stop a person from staying dry?
What happens on your usual route after heavy rain in Rajshahi?
Should a team raise a walkway or clear an outlet first? Why?
Why does water return to the same place after rain?
If water is sent down another lane, who could be affected?
You have 350,000 BDT and 30 days. What one flood-route change would your grant test?

grant.pilot_scope: Test a safe temporary walking route and outlet maintenance at one repeat flooding point.
